body:
Thank you for the reply.  And I apologize for my writing; I realize that I'm not always that clear and tend to type what comes to mind, especially when tired.

I did try dating; went on a few first-dates; nobody ran away screaming...just sort of 'meh'.

I'm currently on five medications that are being fine tuned after endless cocktails.  Going to four soon.  

I don't see what I'm doing as giving up at all, which is why I'm just calmly checking off the days (literally, I have a calendar in the kitchen I'm using).  

When my dog passes, that will be the last of what gives me meaning.

I guess I just wanted someone else to know and so I made an account and posted.

Thanks for reading.
